missable_warning: Positive Mental Attitude is the only missable trophy. Meditate on the balcony in Chapter 1 the first chance you get — once you move past Chapter 1, that spot is gone for the playthrough.
overview: One playthrough plus cleanup, around 200 hours at a 4/10 difficulty. No online trophy is required and nothing is missable except a single meditation spot in Chapter 1. Play the story first, then push 100% completion, then mop up the fiddly trophies that are left.

stages.summary: Play through Chapters 1–5 and finish every story trophy. Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation before you leave Chapter 1. Grab the easy side trophies that sit along the way — fishing with Cal, an arcade game, the stranger strands, a jewelry store robbery, the bowling alley, the garages and the Scooter Bros registrations.
tips: Meditate on the Chapter 1 balcony as soon as the spot is available — it is the only missable trophy in the game.
Stranger missions unlock as the story progresses; check the map for purple markers after each chapter.
Do not worry about 100% yet — story progress already counts toward it.
stages.title: Story — play the five chapters

stages.summary: After the story, work the 100% completion checklist: any 100 optional missions, 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 300 stunts, plus all robberies, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. The checklist is forgiving — roughly 60% true completion — and most of these trophies unlock on the way.
tips: Under the Bridges are the fastest stunts to clear — 202 of them, and you need 300 stunts total for 100%.
Only shooting-range golds matter for The Shootist; no other range requirement exists.
One drone-race win per location is enough for Top Fun — you do not need all 42 races.
Check Progress > Stats > 100% Completion to see exactly what is left.
stages.title: Cleanup — the 100% push

stages.summary: Finish the trophies that need specific setups: the 8 stranger strands, the partner robberies, Combat Focus, the airport plane, the tank, the Ocean Beach cocktail, and the long social and spending counters. Two trophies have no confirmed method at launch — Bad Luck, I Guess and Ten Pin — so check for community updates before chasing them. Then the platinum unlocks.
tips: Hot Together and Retail Therapy both need your partner with you — plan them together.
Gunslinger needs five enemies grouped in one Combat Focus; a busy shootout is the best chance.
Bad Luck, I Guess and Ten Pin have no confirmed method at launch — do not grind blindly for them.
Treat Yo Self grows naturally; big purchases like cars speed it up.
stages.title: Mop-up — the fiddly ones, then platinum

title: Road to the Platinum — Leonida
